tagline: Music first. Music only. Zero gimmicks.
bio: Founded in 2007 by guitarist and songwriter Ed Silva, Cries of Redemption creates honest, cinematic modern rock for the castaways, the misfits, and the broken.

songs.title: Behind The Mask (feat. Sela Hafoka-Hauser)
songs.lyrics:
I wear this shadow like a second skin
A quiet armor for the storm within
Behind the mask nobody sees the scars
We hide the fire beneath the dying stars

Can you hear the voice calling through the night?
We strip the illusion and we face the light.

songs.title: An Eerie Feeling (feat. Luisa Restrepo)
songs.lyrics:
Static in the air, a whisper on the wire
A cold premonition walking through the fire
An eerie feeling creeping down the hall
Waiting for the heavy rain to fall.

songs.title: This Is What It Feels Like (feat. Maria Duque)
songs.lyrics:
Underneath the neon, running out of time
Searching for an answer on the borderline
This is what it feels like when the walls cave in
This is where the story and the truth begin.

songs.title: Tempting Fate (feat. Sela Hafoka-Hauser)
songs.lyrics:
Playing with the thunder, dancing on the edge
Counting every promise broken on the ledge
Tempting fate until the silence breaks in two
There is nothing left to lose with you.

songs.title: Angel (feat. Hege)
songs.lyrics:
Fallen from the canopy, adrift inside the gray
Searching for the pieces that were washed away
Angel in the darkness, lift me from the ground
Where no other sanctuary can be found.

songs.title: Show Me (feat. Sela Hafoka-Hauser)
songs.lyrics:
Show me what remains when the flood recedes
Show me every wound and the heart that bleeds
No more games or promises made in vain
Wash it all away inside the pouring rain.

songs.title: What Lies Beneath (feat. Martina Questa)
songs.lyrics:
Surface looks so calm, but rivers run so deep
Secrets that the twilight promises to keep
What lies beneath the silence and the stone
Is a restless spirit waiting to be known.

songs.title: Impulse (feat. Chiara)
songs.lyrics:
A spark in the chamber, sudden surge of heat
A heavy heart beating to an untamed beat
Impulse driving forward through the pouring night
Until we meet the blinding morning light.

songs.title: Not The Same (feat. Sela Hafoka-Hauser)
songs.lyrics:
Look into the mirror, shadows in the frame
Everything has altered, we are not the same
The fire that consumed us left a quiet space
Now we rebuild inside a different place.

songs.title: Torn (feat. Maria Duque)
songs.lyrics:
Torn at the seams, pulled in two directions
Echoes of the past and bittersweet reflections
Reclaim the ground and let the engines roar
We are not defeated anymore.
